text:
Sightless in the tight confi nes that riddle the island, the krainis hunt within the pitch darkness for the faintest pulse of heat using 
highly sensitive heat pits along its head. Although an expert tracker, the blind serpent lacks accuracy for a single lethal strike, and 
coupled with the cramped tunnels and crevices often being too narrow for the striking motion of a regular snake bite, this subterranean 
dweller has evolved a unique method to administer its venom; with the use of tusk-like lateral fangs that slice instead of pierce. Th ese 
exposed fangs, dripping with venomous runoff, score the cave walls, marking their hunting grounds to limit the competition of other 
krainis, as the deepest areas of the Blackwells can often be devoid of easy prey.

Infrared Senses Th e krainis cannot use its blindsight to 
perceive any creature with a body temperature less than half the 
temperature of its surroundings.
Sightless Senses Th e krainis has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Sinuous Form Th e krainis has Advantage on Strength checks to 
escape a grapple.
Multiattack Th e krainis makes two attacks, it can use its Lateral 
Fangs and Extendable Maw attacks in any combination.
Lateral Fangs Melee Attack Roll:+5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 
14, creature that the krainis has successfully hit with its Lateral 
Fangs attack. Failure: Th e target has the Poisoned condition and 
suffers hallucinations, making it diffi cult to perceive friend from 
foe. Th e creature has Disadvantage on all attack rolls and may 
repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect 
on itself on a success. After 5 minutes, it succeeds automatically.
Extendable Maw Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 6 (1d4+3) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 
10, Small or smaller creature that the krainis has successfully 
hit with its Extendable Maw. Failure: Target is swallowed. A 
swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, 
has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the 
krainis, and takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage at the start of each of 
the krainis’ turns. If the krainis takes 12 damage or more on a 
single turn from a creature inside it, the krainis must succeed 
on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Th row at the end of that turn 
or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a 
space within 5 ft. and has the Prone condition. If the krainis dies, 
swallowed creatures no longer have the Restrained condition 
and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting 
Prone. Th e krainis can swallow up to 2 Small creatures at a time.
Senses Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 30 ft., Passive Perception 14 
Challenge 3 (XP 700; PB 2)
Wary Instinct When Bloodied and in melee combat.
On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 16, the krainis. Success: Th e 
krainis Disengages from combat immediately. Slithering into the 
nearest crevice or tunnel it can see, away from combat.
Skills Perception +4, Stealth +5
Immunities Blinded
Resistances Acid, Poison
Encountering Living solely in the darkest pits of the 
subterranean cave systems of Sol’Kesh, it is quite diffi cult to 
catch this snake in its natural habitat. As it hunts through the 
use of smell, vibrations and heat signatures through cold stone. 
Creating a small fi re or luring it with the scent of scavick fur 
may entice the creature to slither out from its lair.
Having long adapted to the pitch 
darkness of a subterranean existence, 
the krainis eyes have regressed to 
hollow sockets, covered by thick shell-
like scales to help push through the 
tight confines of the cave systems 
Lateral venom ducts run 
cross the hardened exposed 
fangs. Though not as potent as 
other venomous snakes, the 
slashing strike administers 
a large dose of venom into 
open, bleeding wounds
A long thin body, covered with nearly flesh-like 
rubbery scales allows the serpent to squeeze and 
stretch through the narrow confines of the Umbrawells
